slot_scores.name: contract_full_coverage
slot_scores.evidence_quote: For a k-month contract signed at the start of the period, does it provide the full required area for each of months 1 through k (i.e., it covers the requirement in every month it spans), so that the monthly requirement is met by the sum of all active contracts that month?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether a k-month contract must cover every month it spans, which directly targets the full-coverage obligation.

slot_scores.name: demand_exact_satisfaction

slot_scores.rationale: The agent directly asked whether monthly rented area must exactly equal the required area with no surplus or shortage.

slot_scores.name: objective_minimize_cost
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the objective to minimize the total rental cost over the 4 months, with no other costs or constraints (such as a budget cap or a maximum number of contracts)?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly confirmed that the objective is to minimize total rental cost over the four months.
